description.text: Civil engineering，which began enrollment in 2003 and enrolls about 60 students per year, has graduates for 12 years and cumulative number of 720 graduated students. This program is a key construction and new specialty program of Zhejiang Province. There are 16 teachers in this specialty, including 50% of senior title professors, which forms a reasonable teaching and research team of high level of academic qualifications, good title and academic structure and echelon level. In the past years, the program has adopted various strategies to educate featured talents and to promote students' practical capability and cultivating innovation and entrepreneurship by means of academic competitions. The Mycos survey shows that graduates of the program have nearly 100% satisfaction with the university, earn a higher salary than those of similar programs from other non-211 colleges, and have a top employment rate among all graduates of the university。Graduates work in departments of companies and governments for surveying, design, construction, management and research of civil engineering projects in related fields.This training program focuses on the goal of international talent training in civil engineering. First, the program takes advantage of the forestry industry to carry out specialty training. The program established two specialties, which are construction engineering and roads and Bridges, respectively, to improve the training system. Second, the program developed practice base and discipline competition to cultivate innovation consciousness and entrepreneurship. Carry out the construction of diversified practice bases to establish innovation and entrepreneurship platform on campus; Cooperate with many well-known design and construction enterprises to establish many stable off-campus internship bases; Make full use of the college's student innovation platform to cultivate innovative and entrepreneurial talents.This specialty trains with good scientific accomplishment, humanistic accomplishment and professional ethics, can use modern science and technology, master the basic theory and basic knowledge of civil engineering discipline, obtain good training of engineers, solid theoretical and professional knowledge, outstanding practice and innovation ability, and has the consciousness of environmental sustainable development of composite applied talents.Graduation can be competent for housing construction engineering andother related fields of civil engineering project survey, design, construction, management and research work, five years after graduation with independent engineering design capabilities and project management capabilities, and in the construction, design, construction, supervision units and administrative departments to become an important backbone member.core curriculum1.Material of Civil Engineering2.Theoretical Mechanics3.Mechanics of Materials4.Structural Mechanics5.Soil Mechanics6.Hydrologic7.Design Principles of Concrete Structure8.Design Principles of Steel Structure9.Foundation Engineering10.Civil Engineering Construction

duration.text: The Civil Engineering at Zhejiang Agriculture and Forestry University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: For the students who have never studied in China：1.The Photocopy of Passport (the main page and the page with signature) 2.Translated and notarized copy of final degree or diploma and transcript3.Language proficiency certificate4.Non-criminal record or Chinese/English-translated document with an official stamp.5.Other certificates or documents 6.Foreigner physical examination form: bearing the stamp of the hospital. Physical examination results are valid for 6 months7.Application Form For School8.Family Information Form9.Financial Income Statement10.A Short Video of Self Introduction11.Commitment without Drug Use History 12.Photo（format: JPG format, color, 2-inch ID photo, white background , the head occupies 2/3 of the photo, no less than 320 * 240 pixels, aspect ratio is 4: 3, the size is 100-500KB.）For the transferred students who have already studied in China：1.The Photocopy of Passport (the main page and the page with signature) and Visa page2.Translated and notarized copy of final degree or diploma and transcript3.Last semester transcript in the previous school4.Language proficiency certificate5.Non-criminal record or Chinese/English-translated document with an official stamp.6.Transfer letter from last school include the attendance and performance 7.certificate of verification from Entry-Exit inspection and Quarantine within 6 months8.Application Form For School9.Family Information Form10. Financial Income Statement11.A Short Video of Self Introduction12.Commitment without Drug Use History 13.Photo（format: JPG format, color, 2-inch ID photo, white background , the head occupies 2/3 of the photo, no less than 320 * 240 pixels, aspect ratio is 4: 3, the size is 100-500KB.）

requirements.text: 1.年龄要求：18岁-28岁之间 Applicants should be aged between18 and 28 2.非中国籍，持外国有效普通护照的对华友好公民；*中国公民移民外国后申请以外国留学生身份进入高等学校本专科阶段学习的，必须持有有效外国护照或国籍证明文件4年（含）以上，且最近四年（截止入学年度的1月10日前）之内有在国外实际居住2年以上的记录（一年中实际在国外居住满9个月可按一年计算，以入境和出境签章为准）Non-Chinese citizens with valid foreign passports who are friendly to China; * Chinese citizens who apply for admission to colleges and universities as foreign students after immigration must hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for more than 4 years (inclusive), and have a record of actual residence abroad for more than 2 years within the last 4 years (before January 10 of the year of enrollment) (actual residence abroad for more than 9 months in a year can be counted as one year, subject to entry and exit signature
